title: Y.Maps safearea fix
description: Fixes the CarPlay instrument-cluster safe area for Yandex Maps (the iOS app, over CarPlay from an iPhone) on top of waze-on-cluster: moves the guidance-banner rectangle to where Yandex Maps needs it and keeps it there after each boot. CarPlay is iPhone-only, so this is for iOS — not Android Auto. The safe area is one rectangle for every CarPlay app, so this offset is right for Yandex Maps and may misplace the banner on others. Reversible; removing it restores waze-on-cluster's safe area.
